test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: "**led**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Led**" is the past tense of the verb "lead".
 
• It is spelt with just one "e", unlike the noun "lead" which is spelt with two.
 
 
• **Example sentence**: "*John led the team to victory last night.*"
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**lead**", is the present tense of the verb and would not fit in the blank.
 
• "**leading**", is the present participle form and would also not fit in the blank.
 
• "**let**", is a completely different verb and does not make sense in the context of the sentence.
